{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_msb256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_clear;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [15:0] local_winner [0:15];
        wire [3:0] local_code [0:15];

        genvar g, j, b;
        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            if (g == 15) begin : highest_group
                assign group_clear[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : lower_group
                assign group_clear[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_clear[g];

            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                if (j == 15) begin : highest_position
                    assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j];
                end else begin : lower_position
                    assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j]
                        & ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+j+1]);
                end
                if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_position
                    // The original decoder selects bit zero even on an empty input.
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = ~(|input_unencoded[255:1]);
                end else begin : normal_position
                    assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_clear[g] & local_winner[g][j];
                end
            end

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : local_encoding
                wire [15:0] terms;
                for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : positions
                    if ((j & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                        assign terms[j] = local_winner[g][j];
                    end else begin : excluded
                        assign terms[j] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
                assign local_code[g][b] = |terms;
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : global_encoding
            wire [15:0] low_terms;
            wire [15:0] high_terms;
            for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
                assign low_terms[g] = group_clear[g] & local_code[g][b];
                if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                    assign high_terms[g] = group_winner[g];
                end else begin : excluded
                    assign high_terms[g] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
            assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms;
            assign output_encoded[b+4] = |high_terms;
        end
        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    end else begin : original_parameter_behavior
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline computes an encoded index through a priority-selection tree and then decodes that index into 256 outputs. The reported critical path includes this serial encode/decode dependency and heavily loaded shared control signals.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion in parallel, and generate the one-hot output directly without decoding output_encoded. Form the binary index using local-code reductions and group-winner reductions rather than a deep index-multiplexer tree. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The direct one-hot path removes the serial binary-encoding and decoding stages, so a meaningful reduction from the 2.60 ns baseline is expected. No mapped timing result is available; the improvement and new critical endpoint require measurement using the specified flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds explicit local winner and group-exclusion logic while eliminating the 256-way binary-index decoder in the specialized instance. Shared reductions should keep area competitive, but mapped area, the 8862.124480 um^2 cap, and zero electrical violations have not been verified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and MSB priority, output_valid indicates any asserted input, output_encoded is the highest asserted index, and output_unencoded selects that index. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=256'b1, preserving the original ungated default output. Ports, parameter defaults, auxiliary parameters, and fallback truncation and priority behavior are retained. The design is entirely combinational; mapped equivalence remains to be checked."
}
